transcript.content: Hello, I’m glad you came in. What brings you in today?

I'm here because I've been feeling constantly depressed and sad for a very long time now. This low mood has been going on almost every day for about two years and four months. I just can't seem to shake it.
Have you also had any periods of at least two months during that time when your mood felt back to normal, or has it been present כמעט every day the whole time?

No, I haven't had any breaks like that at all. This heavy mood and constant exhaustion have been there almost every single day for the entire two years and four months. I honestly can't remember the last time I felt normal, even for a few weeks.

latest_inference.note: Previously the candidates were [Persistent Depressive Disorder, Major Depressive Disorder], but the patient reports a depressed mood כמעט every day for 2 years and 4 months with no symptom-free period of at least 2 months. That chronic, continuous course fits Persistent Depressive Disorder and makes Major Depressive Disorder less likely as the primary diagnosis because MDD is typically episodic rather than persistently present for over two years without remission.
